method: robocopy /J (unbuffered) copies of the pinned GGUFs; cold run on the copies, then a warm repeat
ioScope: psutil io_counters sampled every 50 ms until exit; includes model reads and output writes
findings: Uncached model files added about 2 s to a 14 s short job on this NVMe drive: generator load 2141 ms vs 995 ms, acoustic model 1275 ms vs 579 ms, decoder 602 ms vs 481 ms
The engine memory-maps its GGUFs, so process read counters (about 31 MB) do not capture model reads
Process writes equal the outputs (about 25.5 MB for the short fixture) and no temporary files were created: peak temporary disk for yue-synth is its output set
The robocopy /J copy ran at about 1.3 GB/s; slower disks will lengthen cold loads proportionally and were not measured
limitations: Unbuffered copies approximate a cold cache without flushing the standby list; the doubled load times indicate the copies were uncached
One cold and one warm run; NVMe only
A 0-byte file appeared under TEMP during the warm run; no yue-synth write accounts for it, so it is attributed to other activity
